Schiff represented the district before Cárdenas. After the 113th Congress commenced, Schiff was redistricted to the 28th district and Cárdenas took Schiff's previous position representing the 29th district

While Adams Schiff is the numerical predecessor for Tony Cárdenas, Schiff and Cárdenas represent completely different constituencies. Cárdenas won election to the 29th in 2012, when it was created as a new majority Hispanic district. Most of his constituency comes from what had been the 28th district (2003-2013) , represented by Howard Berman. Berman chose to seek re-election in the 30th district of Brad Sherman in 2012.
